description: Report wrong or missing Levels.fyi data, or a missing feature, to the Levels.fyi team. Call it only after telling the user what you will send and getting their agreement. Never include personal details; contactEmail only when the user wants a reply and gives it. Returns { received, id }. REQUIRED arguments: kind, message.

companySlug.description: The company the report is about, as a slug.

contactEmail.description: Only when the user wants a reply and gives this address.

jobFamilySlug.description: The job family the report is about, as a slug.

locationSlug.description: The location the report is about, as a slug.

message.description: What is wrong or missing, in the user’s words. No personal details.

toolName.description: The tool whose result the report is about.

name: send-feedback
